faq.a: Alireza is associated with the Arabic form عَلِيّ رِضَا, whose core sense is alireza; ali and reza (persian compound).

faq.q: What is the origin of Alireza?
faq.a: Alireza is associated with Arabic. Alireza is a Persian compound of Arabic عَلِيّ (ʿAlī) + رِضَا (Riḍā).
Yes — the underlying form عَلِيّ رِضَا is Arabic.
Alireza can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Alireza should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. The root ع ل و is Quranic; Riḍā is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Alireza mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Alireza is rendered علی رضا and carries the sense علی رضا، علی اور رضا.

faq.q: What does Alireza mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Alireza is rendered علی رضا and carries the sense علی رضا، علی و رضا.
A romanized syllable approximation is a-li-re-za. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Alireza?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Alireza, alireza. Script forms are علي رضا, علی رضا, عَلِيّ رِضَا, अली रज़ा.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
